Li_normalization_caveat: Ep1995 compilation differs from both ICRU-code parametrization at low velocity and Bader1956 high-energy values. No silent correction; original Ep1995 body remains unavailable.
availability: Ep1995 and Ph1953 primary editions unavailable; these are source-tabulated compilation claims, not unseen primary tables. Bs1979 original monograph Fig5 p16 read; its stated2.5percent two-sigma differs from compiled1.3percent unspecified error.
errors: Retain original percentage_error text; no automatic conversion to one sigma.
handoff: Fixed70keV/u lies within both H data ranges; evaluate/report the literal H source mismatch at handoff. No forced continuity.
policy: Literal IAEA2026-09 proton rows, interpolation within each observed range only. No scaling or normalization fit. Li+oneH per formula, H2 source already per atom, gas/metal Bragg compound approximation.
